spans.s: घुष् (I) vt. 1P, 10U (pp. घुषित or घुष्ट) 1. To sound; 2. to proclaim aloud, to announce publicly, to declare, e.g.

डिंडिमः करिणो हस्तिपकाहताः क्वणन्, or घोषयतु मन्मथनिदेशम् (रसना) Git.G.x., R.ix.10.With आ-, to announce publicly (according to some authorities), Bt.iii.2, to weep (according to others).With उद्-, to proclaim aloud, to announce publicly.
घुष् (II) vi. 1Ā (pres. घुषते) To be beautiful or brilliant.
